name: opportunity-engine-coaches
description: Free AI coaches built on Mark Cheren's adult-learning research: one for jobs, small business, and more education in the United States, and a Kenya version for Partners for Care graduates.

plugins.name: opportunity-engine
plugins.description: A free AI coach built on Mark Cheren's adult-learning research for choosing and pursuing a job, a business of your own, or more education: training, an apprenticeship, college, finishing a degree, or graduate school. It runs an intake, asks how much help you want, builds a plan you own, and can write a short report for your human coach.

plugins.name: kenya-opportunity-engine
plugins.description: A free AI coach for Partners for Care graduates in Kenya choosing a job, a business, or further training. Built on Mark Cheren's adult-learning research, with Kenya-specific guidance and safety rules for refugees.
